scope: Explicit opt-in review models and bounded read-only review probes.

instruction_changes.deviation: The reviewer handoff did not describe disposable probe writes and the standing model route did not offer an explicit opt-in review pass through Terra or Claude Free.
instruction_changes.evidence: The user selected both opt-in routes and requested execution of missing final-revision probes.
instruction_changes.why_instruction: Reviewer dispatch and read-only scope are decided from the shared instruction owner.
instruction_changes.alternative: Changing the default reviewer would spend capacity on ordinary tasks and would not settle probe ownership.

user_preference.request: Add opt-in GPT-6.1 Terra and Sonnet 5.5 on Claude Free review passes and run missing material probes in a safe isolated runner.
user_preference.scope: Requested additional code review passes and authorized read-only code verification.

change_reconciliation.authority: Explicit user request to implement opt-in reviewers and final-revision probe rules.
change_reconciliation.requirement_reason: Apply an opt-in review preference within existing scoped orchestration and verification requirements.
change_reconciliation.checks: Canonical renderer, recovery manifest and artifact-only instruction profile checks. Local production-path replay with a simulated review request.

outcome_review.expected: Opt-in selection and isolated probes are available without changing default roles. A missing final-head runtime observation delays the simulated review request.
outcome_review.observed: The renderer projects the shared source. The final-head runtime probe ran before the mock review request.
outcome_review.evidence: The scoped local Windows workflow replay and render/profile checks.
outcome_review.limitations: The replay isolates one behavior claim and uses a simulated review request. It does not measure comparative model quality or host-wide parity.
